architecture_summary: Modular React app. Core: design system components (src/components/), pages (src/pages/), router (react-router-dom), state (zustand). Styling: TailwindCSS. No custom CSS files. One component per file. Shared props via TypeScript interfaces. Lazy load pages. Error boundaries wrap routes. 404 variants consolidated into single page with dynamic illustration.

tickets.title: Design system foundation - button, badge, card components
tickets.description: Convert Stitch buttons, badges, cards to React components. Use Tailwind for styling. Extract shared props (size, variant, disabled) into TypeScript interfaces. Support all variants shown in screens. Add Storybook stories for visual regression testing.
acceptance_criteria: All variants (primary, secondary, danger, etc.) work

tickets.title: Design system - input, toast, loader components
tickets.description: Build input fields (text, select, checkbox), toast notifications, skeleton loaders. Inputs: support validation states (error, success). Toasts: auto-dismiss, position top-right. Loaders: animated, match design system colors. Use Tailwind. Add Storybook stories.
acceptance_criteria: Inputs support all types (text, password, select, checkbox)
Loaders animate smoothly, match design colors

tickets.title: Design system - table, tab components
tickets.description: Build table and tab components. Tables: support sorting, pagination. Tabs: horizontal/vertical layouts, active state styling. Use Tailwind. Add Storybook stories.

tickets.title: Feature highlights page (src/pages/FeatureHighlights.tsx)
tickets.description: Convert feature highlights screen to React page. Use design system components (cards, buttons, badges). Implement responsive layout. Add placeholder for dynamic content (courses, testimonials).
acceptance_criteria: Uses design system components (no custom styling)

tickets.title: Playful bento showcase page (src/pages/BentoShowcase.tsx)
tickets.description: Convert playful bento showcase screen to React page. Implement grid layout with responsive breakpoints. Use design system components. Add placeholder for dynamic course cards.

tickets.title: 404 error page with dynamic illustrations (src/pages/NotFound.tsx)
tickets.description: Build single 404 page with dynamic illustration system. Randomly select one of three illustrations on load. Use design system components. Add 'Go Home' button with router link.
acceptance_criteria: Page shows random illustration on load
'Go Home' button links to home page

tickets.title: Global state management (zustand store)
tickets.description: Set up zustand store for global state (user auth, theme, notifications). Create slices for auth, theme, notifications. Add TypeScript types. Persist auth state to localStorage.
acceptance_criteria: zustand store created with auth, theme, notifications slices

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Build app shell with navigation bar. Set up react-router-dom with lazy-loaded routes. Add error boundaries. Implement responsive navigation (mobile menu). Use design system components. Route structure: / (home), /features, /bento, /404.
acceptance_criteria: react-router-dom set up with lazy-loaded routes
